name: ui-start
prompt: Short bright tap on a wooden dock plank with a soft small brass bell chirp, friendly game-start confirmation for a seaside harbor puzzle game.

name: tool-move
prompt: Light wooden slide and soft knock of a small hand tool being dragged one cell across a rough dock plank, dry and quiet.

name: tool-merge
prompt: Two small wooden tools clack together followed by a bright pitched-up metallic clink sparkle, a satisfying merge upgrade in a puzzle game.

name: deliver
prompt: Coiled rope thump onto a wooden crate with a small brass bell ding, a package being delivered at a harbor market stall.

name: task-complete
prompt: Cheerful small harbor bell rung twice with a warm wooden creak, a commission completed fanfare, cozy and rewarding.

name: tide-spawn
prompt: Gentle water splash with a soft wooden plop as the tide drops fresh supplies onto a dock, light and playful.

name: round-advance
prompt: Distant ship horn swell followed by a single seagull cry over calm harbor water, a new round beginning.

name: tasks-new
prompt: Paper note flutter and a pin tapping into a wooden notice board, a new task list being posted at a harbor.

name: win
prompt: Joyful harbor bells pealing with seagull cries and a warm small brass fanfare, a cozy seaside victory celebration.

name: lose
prompt: Low foghorn moan with a sad wooden hull creak and fading water lapping, a gentle non-punishing defeat.

name: invalid-move
prompt: Dull muted wooden thunk with a short rubbery bounce, a rejected action error sound, soft and not harsh.

name: resign
prompt: Soft descending boatswain whistle with a rope being lowered and a quiet water splash, calmly giving up a round.
